shell_fixer: Finding 20 (save-scumming with the deterministic map seed plus the «Antes da missão» save) was skipped: it needs sim/contract changes, since the save slots are fixed in CAMPAIGN_API and G.rng belongs to the sim. Proposed patch, option A: add `OV.Campaign.reseedMap(G, salt)` in js/sim/campaign.js, which XORs the 'map' stream state with salt (`G.rng.map.s = (G.rng.map.s ^ (salt >>> 0)) >>> 0`). The UI would call it with a salt from its own 'ui' stream right after loading the preMission slot when G.difficulty === 2, keeping replays deterministic per load. Option B: add an `ironman` flag to newCampaign that disables the preMission and autoTurn slots in OV.Save.save. Either needs a DESIGN/CAMPAIGN_API decision.

Battle fixer (battle_ui/input, not mine): on Mac there is no keyboard way to force a shot. forceMods only accepts meta on Mac, and input.js drops every ⌘+key except ⌘ alone, so ⌘+Enter never arrives; the help line «Ctrl + Enter · …» (scr.howto.key.18) is wrong on Mac. Suggested fix: in battle_ui.js accept `m.ctrl && key === 'Enter'` as a forced shot on every platform (Ctrl+Enter is not the secondary click on the keyboard).
